result.excerpt:
**Brooklyn neighborhood maps**

The Brooklyn neighborhood maps list is at **https://www.mta.info/maps/neighborhood-maps/brooklyn** — the address new.mta.info serves these pages from. The page is headed "Brooklyn neighborhood maps".

It lists **168 map entries covering 134 different Brooklyn stations**; a station appears more than once when it has separate maps for different line groups (e.g. 4 Av–9 St has one map for F/G and one for R).
